problematicWording.ru: Люди цепенеют, пока Сильвер не убеждает их, что это живой Бен Ганн.
problematicWording.en: The men freeze until Silver persuades them it is the living Ben Gunn.

requiredFindings.effectOnMeaning: Replaces the source’s comic reason for recovering courage with a claim that Silver proves Ben alive. Silver first argues from an echo and then recognises Ben’s voice. Dick explicitly says Ben is no more alive/present in the body than Flint; the others are untroubled because nobody minds Ben, dead or alive. That contrast is the joke and the reason they continue, not settled belief that Ben is living.

anchors: Ben Gunn’s not here in the body any more’n Flint.
dead or alive, nobody minds him.

smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.ru: Убрать «живой» и сохранить причину облегчения: Сильвер узнаёт голос Бена Ганна; Бена они не боятся ни живым, ни мёртвым, и идут дальше.
smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.en: Remove the assertion of living Ben and retain the comic cause: Silver recognises Ben Gunn’s voice; alive or dead, nobody fears Ben, so they continue.

requiredFindings.closureValidation: Parent may correct this short bilingual ending of the screen without adding a scene/screen; publisher checks against XXXII and records replacement hashes.

problematicWording.ru: при помощи Бена, который боялся его мести
problematicWording.en: with a bag of coins and Ben’s help: Ben feared his revenge

requiredFindings.effectOnMeaning: Fear of Silver is explicit, but the retelling specifies revenge as an established motive. XXXIV calls Ben terribly afraid of his old quartermaster; after the escape Ben claims he assisted it to preserve the others’ lives if Silver stayed aboard. The story may condense that fear but should not add the particular revenge motive as narrator-established fact.

anchors: Ben Gunn, who was still terribly afraid of his old quartermaster
he now assured us he had only done so to preserve our lives

smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.ru: Самая маленькая правка: «при помощи Бена, который боялся Сильвера». Если сохранять объяснение самого Бена, атрибутировать его: Бен уверял, что так спасал их жизни.
smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.en: Smallest edit: “with Ben’s help; Ben was afraid of Silver.” Alternatively attribute Ben’s explanation: he claimed the escape would preserve their lives.

requiredFindings.closureValidation: Remove only the unsupported revenge specificity, or use Ben’s attributed assurance; no new motive, speech or later fate. Publisher records new hashes.

readerJudgment.story: The rebuilt narrative preserves Jim’s dread and excitement, Silver’s friendly façade, betrayal and self-preservation, Ben’s oddness, cramped stockade, sea danger, treasure disclosure and uneasy homecoming. No lesson/exercise block or invented dialogue found. Two short source corrections are needed; no wholesale rewrite is warranted.
readerJudgment.routes: Essential 12 and Core 20 coherently stop after the stockade attack. Deep 34 continues through ship recovery, captivity, treasure and home. The shorter routes deliberately retain the central secrets.
readerJudgment.parity: No material RU/EN reversal; both required source issues are shared.
readerJudgment.uncertainty: Silver’s future is not invented; Arrow’s disappearance is not turned into a witnessed murder. Hands’s shots remain involuntary; Ben’s treasure work is disclosed when the story explains it.
